name: @qu/app-core
description: Qu V5 App Runtime core: the Kind-Schemas for application content (qu-app manifest, qu-route-registry, qu-page, qu-template, qu-style), content-addressed Node ids, ContentResolver, a hash Router, AppRuntime (wires resolver+router+@qu/app-renderer together), and a small Dev/Admin API to bootstrap an empty Space into a working app. Built entirely on @qu/space-core's public API - never a Space/relay-side special case.
